definitions.explanation: A track and field event in which athletes throw a spear-shaped implement (javelin) as far as possible.

examples.japanese: やり{投|な}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なりたい→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I want to become a javelin thrower.

examples.japanese: やり{投|な}げ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{金|きん}メダル→金メダル：20781_kinmedaru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Won a gold medal in the javelin throw.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧やり{投|な}げ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{日本記録|にほんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}した→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧。
examples.english: He set a new Japanese record in the javelin throw.

notes:
One of the throwing events in track and field (⟦{陸上競技|りくじょうきょうぎ}→陸上競技：06604_rikujoukyougi⟧). The javelin ({槍|やり}) is thrown from behind a foul line after a running approach.
